text: FCSubsetQ[list1, list2] yields True if list2 is a subset of list1 and False otherwise. It returns the same results as the standard SubsetQ. The only reason for introducing FCSubsetQ is that SubsetQ is not available in Mathematica 8 and 9, which are still supported by FeynCalc.
FCSubsetQ[{a, b, c, d}, {a, d, e}]
